WITH dup AS (
 SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-15' AND DATE '2025-11-02'
 GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.sale_ts_utc, f.store_key, f.product_key, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.standard_cost, f.channel_code, f.etl_loaded_at
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dup USING (receipt_id, line_no)
ORDER BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sales_line_id LIMIT 24

WITH x AS (
 SELECT f.*, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no) AS n, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY sales_line_id) AS rn
 FROM fact_sales_line f)
SELECT min(sale_date) AS mn, max(sale_date) AS mx, count(*) FILTER (WHERE rn>1) AS extra_rows, count(DISTINCT sale_date) FILTER (WHERE rn>1) AS days,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE rn>1 AND channel_code='WB') AS web_extra, max(n) AS maxn,
 min(etl_loaded_at) FILTER (WHERE rn>1) AS load_min, max(etl_loaded_at) FILTER (WHERE rn>1) AS load_max,
 sum(net_amount) FILTER (WHERE rn>1) AS extra_net,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE rn>1 AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-22' AND DATE '2025-10-26') AS extra_in_p6
FROM x WHERE n>1

WITH params AS (SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 6 AS fiscal_period),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku, p.category AS cat_was,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND NOT (s.store_id = 900 AND w.web_order_id IS NULL)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, p.category, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT cp.category AS as_is, n.cat_was AS as_was, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales),2) AS net_sales, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost),2) AS gm,
  ROUND(100.0*SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost)/SUM(n.net_sales),2) AS gm_pct, count(*) AS n
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
CROSS JOIN params
WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year AND d.fiscal_period = params.fiscal_period
  AND (cp.category IN ('Garden','Electrical') OR n.cat_was IN ('Garden','Electrical'))
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH params AS (SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 6 AS first_period, 6 AS last_period),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
by_category AS (
    SELECT cp.category, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost) AS gross_margin
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d     ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
      AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period
      AND cp.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT category, 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 6 AS fiscal_period, ROUND(net_sales, 2) AS net_sales,
       ROUND(100.0 * gross_margin / net_sales, 1) AS gross_margin_pct
FROM by_category
ORDER BY category
